name: Neo4j 5.26 LTS Community
description: Graph database with Browser over HTTPS, Bolt via TCP proxy, daily backups

upstream.license: Neo4j Community Edition: GPL-3.0; APOC core: Apache-2.0

PORT.description: Port of the HTTPS entry point (Caddy: Neo4j Browser, HTTP API and Bolt over WebSocket).

DB_USER.description: Database user (Neo4j's built-in admin user; informational, referenced by the backup job).

DB_PASSWORD.description: Password of the neo4j user (min. 8 characters). Set on the first boot; later only with DB_PASSWORD_RESET=true.

DB_PASSWORD_RESET.description: true = set the neo4j user's password to DB_PASSWORD on the next boot (recovery). Set back to false afterwards.

BOLT_ADVERTISED_ADDRESS.description: host:port drivers are told to use (the Railway TCP proxy to Bolt).

BOLT_TLS.description: TLS on Bolt with a self-signed certificate: disabled, optional (default) or required.

HEAP_SIZE.description: JVM heap, e.g. 1g or 4g. auto = 30% of the memory limit, 256m-1g.

PAGECACHE_SIZE.description: Page cache for graph data, e.g. 1g or 8g. auto = 20% of the memory limit, 128m-1g.

PLUGINS.description: JSON list of Neo4j plugins (APOC is bundled; others such as graph-data-science are downloaded at boot).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Neo4j gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.

DB_HTTP_PORT.description: Neo4j HTTP API port on the private network (export).

DB_BOLT_PORT.description: Neo4j Bolt port on the private network (restore).

DB_NAME.description: Database to back up and restore.

DB_USER.description: User for backups (kept in sync by reference).

DB_PASSWORD.description: Password of that user (kept in sync by reference).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for Neo4j before failing.

RESTORE_RUN.description: Restore only (start command /usr/local/bin/neo4j-backup restore): run folder, or latest. Loads only into an empty database.
